issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Enterprise Fund) 87,345.32; Enterprise disbursements are Solid Waste, Wastewater, Water
issues.issue: The extractor treated this unexplained Enterprise Fund line as service charges. If that is right, the user's rule puts utility fund charges in Utility Charges. If it is not, the line is unexplained and belongs in other. Either way this is a judgment call.
